mechanism: Carbamazepine induces valproic acid metabolism via CYP450 enzymes, reducing valproic acid levels by 25-50%, while valproic acid inhibits carbamazepine metabolism and increases its levels, creating reciprocal pharmacokinetic interactions with potential loss of seizure control or carbamazepine toxicity.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if combination is necessary, monitor antiepileptic drug levels (target valproic acid 50-100 mcg/mL, carbamazepine 4-12 mcg/mL) and seizure control closely, and adjust doses accordingly.
